biography: Fernando Fortes, a name synonymous with flamboyant speed in the Brazilian motorsport scene, hails from the vibrant favelas of Rio de Janeiro. His journey began not on asphalt, but on the treacherous dirt tracks of karting, a world he entered at the age of 12, fuelled by a burning desire to escape the confines of his surroundings. Early races were often won in borrowed karts, cobbled together from spare parts, but his raw talent shone through, attracting the attention of a local patron who sponsored his entry into Formula Vee. A defining moment came at Interlagos in 2018 when, despite starting from the back of the grid due to a mechanical issue, Fortes carved his way through the field, executing a daring last-lap overtake to secure victory. Now, at 26, he finds himself piloting the powerful MetalMoro MRX P2, a testament to his unwavering ambition and relentless pursuit of racing glory. His career is at its peak, and all eyes are on him to see if he can conquer the Brazilian Endurance Championship.
drivingStyle: Fortes is a driver who lives on the edge. His driving style is characterized by late braking, aggressive corner entries, and an uncanny ability to extract maximum performance from his tires. He's known for his audacious overtaking maneuvers, often pushing the limits of grip and leaving spectators breathless. While this approach can lead to spectacular results, it also carries inherent risks, with the occasional crash serving as a stark reminder of his high-risk, high-reward philosophy. He excels under pressure, thriving in tense situations where his raw talent and unwavering confidence can shine.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Vieira
rivalries.reason: A long-standing rivalry stemming from their karting days, Vieira often criticizes Fortes's aggressive driving, labeling him reckless and dangerous.

rivalries.name: Isabela Costa
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track battle for the Brazilian Endurance Championship title in 2022 saw several heated exchanges and near-miss collisions, fueling a bitter rivalry.

rivalries.name: Thiago Mendes
rivalries.reason: Mendes felt Fortes intentionally blocked him during qualifying at Curitiba in 2021, costing him a crucial grid position. The two exchanged heated words in the paddock afterwards.

quirks: Always wears a lucky pair of socks gifted to him by his grandmother.
Listens to a specific samba song before every race to calm his nerves and get in the zone.
Refuses to start a race without first tapping the top of his helmet three times.
famousQuote: "Second place is just the first loser. I race to win, and I'll do whatever it takes to get there."
careerHighlight: Winning the Brazilian Formula Vee Championship in 2019, a victory that secured his future in motorsport and proved his doubters wrong.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final round of the 2021 Brazilian Endurance Championship at Interlagos, costing him the title and leaving him devastated.
